# BIM Guard

> BIM Guard reads IFC models directly, runs architectural code compliance rules, and routes findings as BCF issues, with ISO 19650 CDE governance.

BIM Guard is an OpenBIM compliance platform: upload IFC models and regulatory documents, extract rules, run audits, and route findings as BCF issues under ISO 19650. The app itself is behind sign-in; the pages below are public.

## Product

- [BIM Guard features](https://bim-guard.xyz/features.md): Automated architectural code compliance for IFC models, ISO 19650 CDE governance, BCF issue coordination, IDS validation and bSDD classification.
- [Automated IFC compliance checking](https://bim-guard.xyz/ifc-compliance-checking.md): Check IFC models against architectural building-code rules automatically: egress travel distance, exit counts and daylight ratios, with results as BCF issues.
- [ISO 19650 and CDE governance](https://bim-guard.xyz/iso-19650-cde.md): Validate ISO 19650 container naming, suitability and revision codes, and enforce CDE state transitions from WIP to SHARED, PUBLISHED and ARCHIVED.
- [BCF issue management and IDS validation](https://bim-guard.xyz/bcf-and-ids.md): Export compliance findings as BCF issues, expose a BCF REST API, and generate, import and audit buildingSMART IDS specifications.
- [Validation and research](https://bim-guard.xyz/research.md): BIM Guard's accuracy claims are scored in a separate public repository and published with their limits: benchmark results, a claims ledger and known gaps.
- [Self-hosted, on-premises BIM validation with local LLMs](https://bim-guard.xyz/self-hosted-bim-validation.md): Run BIM Guard on your own infrastructure with Docker Compose and point its language-model features at a local Ollama server.

## API and agents

- [OpenAPI schema](https://bim-guard.xyz/api/openapi.json): Machine-readable REST API description
- [Interactive API docs](https://bim-guard.xyz/api/docs): Swagger UI for the REST API
- [Authentication for agents](https://bim-guard.xyz/auth.md): How to obtain and use a bearer token
- [API catalog](https://bim-guard.xyz/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset of API descriptions
- [MCP server card](https://bim-guard.xyz/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Model Context Protocol server metadata
- [OAuth protected-resource metadata](https://bim-guard.xyz/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): RFC 9728 sign-in discovery for the MCP endpoint
- [MCP endpoint](https://bim-guard.xyz/mcp/): Streamable HTTP MCP server (bearer token or OAuth); see https://bim-guard.xyz/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
